title: Big Data and Artificial Intelligence in Cancer Drug Discovery: Promise, Challenges, and Emerging Opportunities.
snippet: Oncologic drug development is lengthy (~14 years) and expensive (~1.2 billion USD) with low clinical trial success rates (4.1%).
